description: This file is a C/C++ header defining APIs and documentation for the TR-069 Device.IP.Diagnostics.UploadDiagnostics object, including setter functions for diagnostic parameters related to uploading diagnostics via HTTP/FTP, as well as associated macros, includes, and license information.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the DiagnosticsState parameter to initiate or query the status of the upload diagnostics test, supporting various states including Requested, Completed, and error states.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Configures the IP-layer interface (or default) over which the diagnostic test is performed.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_UploadURL
methods.description: Sets the URL (HTTP or FTP) to which the device will upload diagnostics data.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for marking packets during the diagnostic test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Ethernet priority code for marking packets transmitted during the test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_TestFileLength
methods.description: Configures the size of the file (in bytes) to be uploaded during diagnostics.
